articles.title: Controlled Attribute-Specific Summarization of Interrogative Dialogues
articles.zh: 面向疑问式对话的可控属性特定摘要生成
articles.summary: 如果你在客服或访谈类内容里做摘要，这篇给了一个能按属性挑着总结对话的方法
articles.author: A Aditya Bhardwaj, Arjit Singh Arora 等
articles.body: Effective summarization of interrogative dialogues is a critical task in forensic and investigative settings, requiring high factual accuracy, coherence, and attribute-specific relevance. In this work, we introduce CASPER, a novel Chain-of-Thought Attribute-Specific Prompting for Evaluative Summarization framework that leverages structured prompting and iterative refinement to generate high-quality summaries of interrogator-witness interactions. We construct MINDSum, a dataset extending the MIND corpus, comprising 6,000 utterance pairs annotated with event details, factual statements, character descriptions, and fillers. CASPER employs RoleEval, a hierarchical evaluation mechanism where multiple roles (officer, inspector, senior inspector) iteratively assess summaries based on predefined criteria. By integrating entity extraction and structured feedback loops, CASPER significantly improves factual consistency and contextual completeness compared to existing baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms standard summarization models on both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) metrics, while human evaluation confirms its alignment with expert reasoning. Our findings underscore the potential of controlled summarization in high-stakes domains, paving the way for AI-driven forensic intelligence.
articles.bodyZh: 把审讯式对话（interrogative dialogues）高效地总结好，在司法/法务（forensic）和调查（investigative）场景里是个特别关键的任务，因为这类摘要得事实高度准确、前后连贯，还得抓住属性特定相关性（attribute-specific relevance）。在这项工作里，我们提出了 CASPER，一个全新的、面向评估式摘要（evaluative summarization）的“思维链+属性特定提示”框架（Chain-of-Thought Attribute-Specific Prompting for Evaluative Summarization）。它靠结构化提示（structured prompting）和反复优化（iterative refinement），来生成审讯人员与证人互动（interrogator-witness interactions）的高质量摘要。我们还构建了 MINDSum，这是在 MIND 语料库（MIND corpus）基础上扩展出来的数据集，包含 6000 组话语对（utterance pairs），每组都标注了事件细节、事实陈述、人物描述和填充语（fillers）。CASPER 用的是 RoleEval，这是一种分层评估机制（hierarchical evaluation mechanism），让多个角色——警官（officer）、督察（inspector）、高级督察（senior inspector）——根据预先定好的标准，一轮一轮地评估摘要。通过把实体提取（entity extraction）和结构化反馈闭环（structured feedback loops）结合起来，CASPER 跟现有基线（baseline）相比，在事实一致性（factual consistency）和上下文完整性（contextual completeness）上都有明显提升。实验结果显示，我们的框架在词汇指标（ROUGE）和语义指标（BERTScore）上都超过了标准摘要模型，人工评估也证实，它跟专家推理（expert reasoning）更对得上。这些发现突显了受控摘要（controlled summarization）在高风险领域里的潜力，也为 AI 驱动的法务情报（AI-driven forensic intelligence）铺平了道路。

articles.title: Compliant with Local Controls, Collectively Discriminatory. A Governance Architecture for Multi-Agent AI in Regulated Finance
articles.zh: 局部合规、整体歧视——受监管金融场景下多Agent AI的治理架构
articles.summary: 如果你在做金融类Agent产品，这篇提醒你每个Agent单独合规不等于系统整体不歧视
articles.author: Jose Manuel de la Chica Rodriguez, Juan Manuel Vera Diaz 等
articles.body: Financial institutions are beginning to deploy agentic workflows in credit, fraud, collections, compliance, and operational control. Governance remains largely component-centric: each model or agent is specified, tested, authorized, and monitored locally. That is insufficient when institutional risk arises from the joint behavior of many locally acceptable components. We call this gap constitutional non-compositionality: local compliance checks need not compose into acceptable collective outcomes such as bounded disparate impact, market integrity, or traceable accountability. We propose ARIA as a finance-specific reference architecture and falsifiable research agenda for agent-population governance. It organizes six capabilities across normative-accountability, execution-control, and assurance-learning planes: policy specification, population-level observed-versus-expected behavior monitoring (M2), bounded authority, runtime containment, adaptive policy change, and preserved human oversight competence. Two simulations illustrate shared-signal thin-file exclusion under local controls and earlier warning from observed-versus-expected distributional monitoring in a constructed drift regime. The contribution maps these controls to fair-lending, EU AI Act, model-risk, and conduct-supervision evidence needs, and closes with a validation agenda rather than a production-effectiveness claim.
articles.bodyZh: 金融机构现在开始把智能体工作流（agentic workflows）用到信贷、欺诈识别、催收、合规和运营控制这些地方。可治理方式大体上还是围着单个组件转：每个模型或智能体都单独定规则、单独测试、单独授权、单独监控。问题是，当机构层面的风险来自一堆局部看都没问题的组件凑在一起的行为时，这种办法就不够用了。我们把这个缺口叫作“宪制层面的不可组合性”（constitutional non-compositionality）：局部的合规检查，不一定能拼成整体上可接受的结果，比如差别影响有边界、市场保持诚信、责任能追溯。为此，我们提出 ARIA，作为一套专门面向金融的参考架构（reference architecture），也是一份针对智能体群体治理（agent-population governance）的可证伪研究议程（falsifiable research agenda）。它把六项能力分到三个层面：规范-问责（normative-accountability）、执行-控制（execution-control）和保证-学习（assurance-learning）。这六项能力是：策略定义（policy specification）、群体层面“实际表现对预期表现”的行为监控（M2，population-level observed-versus-expected behavior monitoring）、有边界的权限（bounded authority）、运行时遏制（runtime containment）、自适应政策变更（adaptive policy change），以及保留人类监督能力（preserved human oversight competence）。两个模拟展示了两种情形：一是局部控制下，共享信号会把信用档案很薄的人排除在外（shared-signal thin-file exclusion）；二是在构造出来的漂移状态（drift regime）里，用“实际对预期”的分布监控（distributional monitoring）能更早发出预警。这项工作的贡献，是把这些控制措施对应到公平贷款（fair-lending）、欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act）、模型风险（model-risk）和行为监管（conduct-supervision）所需要的证据上；结尾给的是验证议程，而不是宣称这套东西在生产环境里已经有效（production-effectiveness claim）。

articles.title: Riemannian Structure and Optimization for a Class of Low-Parametric Orthogonal Matrices
articles.zh: 一类低参数正交矩阵的黎曼结构与优化
articles.summary: 如果你不碰正交约束和流形优化，这篇可以跳过；相关方向的话是个理论工具
articles.author: Ali Aliev, Maxim Rakhuba
articles.body: In this paper, we are concerned with matrices formed by block-diagonal factors interleaved with fixed permutations -- a flexible family of structured matrices. This class has recently drawn interest in deep learning architectures for its balanced expressivity-efficiency trade-off, yet efficient computational strategies for working with it remain to be found. We approach this problem through Riemannian geometry and examine under what conditions this class admits a smooth manifold structure. For the practically important case of orthogonal two-factor matrices, we derive the essential Riemannian tools and propose efficient algorithms for their implementation. The algorithms leverage automatic differentiation, support parameter sharing within each factor, and avoid explicit dense matrix construction. We test them within the Riemannian optimization framework on the best matrix approximation problem and for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Beyond the two-factor setting, we study the geometric and matrix-theoretic properties of factorizations with a larger number of block-diagonal factors.
articles.bodyZh: 这篇论文里，我们关注的是一类由块对角因子（block-diagonal factors）和固定置换（fixed permutations）交错拼出来的矩阵，也就是一族很灵活的结构化矩阵（structured matrices）。最近，这类矩阵在深度学习架构（deep learning architectures）里越来越受关注，因为它能在表达能力和效率之间取得不错的平衡（expressivity-efficiency trade-off）；但怎么高效地计算它、拿它干活，仍然是个没解决的问题。我们走黎曼几何（Riemannian geometry）这条路，来研究在什么条件下，这类矩阵能拥有光滑流形（smooth manifold）结构。对于实际中特别重要的正交双因子矩阵（orthogonal two-factor matrices）情形，我们推导了必需的黎曼几何工具，并提出了高效算法来落地。这些算法借助自动微分（automatic differentiation），支持在每个因子内部共享参数，而且不用显式做稠密矩阵构造（dense matrix construction）。我们在黎曼优化（Riemannian optimization）框架下测试了它们，用在最佳矩阵近似问题（best matrix approximation problem）和大型语言模型（large language models）的参数高效微调（parameter-efficient fine-tuning）上。除了双因子这种设定，我们还研究了包含更多块对角因子的分解，看看它们在几何和矩阵论性质（matrix-theoretic properties）方面有什么特点。

articles.title: Risk-Controlled KV-Cache Eviction: From Memory Budgets to Risk Targets
articles.zh: 风险可控的KV-Cache淘汰：从内存预算到风险目标
articles.summary: 如果你被长上下文推理的显存卡住，这篇把KV-Cache淘汰从"拍脑袋定预算"变成了"按风险目标来裁"
articles.author: Beomgu Kang, SoJin Yun 等
articles.body: KV-cache eviction is typically evaluated through average quality-memory trade-offs, yet a small average loss can hide requests whose utility degrades materially. We reformulate eviction as a deployment risk-control problem: a material degradation occurs when eviction lowers task utility by more than a deployment-specified tolerance relative to full-KV inference on the same request, and deployment risk is the population frequency of such events. Given a reliability contract specifying a target risk level and confidence requirement, we use a compressor-agnostic post-hoc certification procedure to select a retention policy from calibration data with a finite-sample guarantee, falling back to full KV when no compressed policy is certified. Across multiple eviction methods, Llama and Mistral models, and LongBench and RULER-32K, the same contract supports substantially different levels of eviction: on Llama, it certifies SnapKV at 75% retention on LongBench but no tested compressed policy on RULER-32K, triggering full-KV fallback. Policies with empirical degradation rates below the 5% target can still fail finite-sample certification; on Llama LongBench, empirical thresholding selects uncertified policies that retain 5-10 percentage points less cache across fixed-budget methods. The proposed framework converts a deployment-level reliability requirement into a KV-memory operating point.
articles.bodyZh: 大家一般评估 KV 缓存淘汰（KV-cache eviction），都是看平均质量跟内存之间的权衡（average quality-memory trade-offs），可平均下来只掉一点点，很容易把某些请求的问题盖住——这些请求的可用性其实已经明显变差了。我们换个角度，把淘汰当成部署时的风险控制问题（deployment risk-control problem）来看：所谓实质性退化（material degradation），就是同一个请求，淘汰之后的任务效用（task utility）比全量 KV 推理（full-KV inference）低，而且低得超过了部署方设定的容忍范围（deployment-specified tolerance）；部署风险（deployment risk）就是这种情况在整体请求里出现的频率。给定一份可靠性契约（reliability contract），里面写清楚目标风险水平和置信度要求（target risk level and confidence requirement），我们就用一个跟具体压缩器无关的事后认证流程（compressor-agnostic post-hoc certification procedure），从校准数据（calibration data）里挑一个保留策略（retention policy），并且带有有限样本保证（finite-sample guarantee）；要是没有任何压缩策略（compressed policy）能通过认证，就退回全量 KV（full KV）。我们试了多种淘汰方法、Llama 和 Mistral 模型，还有 LongBench 和 RULER-32K，结果发现，同一份契约能支持的淘汰力度差别很大：在 Llama 上，它能在 LongBench 认证 SnapKV 保留 75% 的缓存，但在 RULER-32K 上，所有测过的压缩策略都没法认证，只能触发全量 KV 回退。有些策略实测退化率（empirical degradation rates）明明低于 5% 的目标，还是可能过不了有限样本认证；在 Llama + LongBench 上，靠经验阈值（empirical thresholding）去选，会选出没通过认证的策略，而在固定预算方法（fixed-budget methods）里，这些策略会少保留 5 到 10 个百分点的缓存。我们提出的这套框架，能把部署层面的可靠性要求，直接换算成一个 KV 内存的工作点（KV-memory operating point）。

articles.title: Six Layers Less: Encoder Pruning for Whisper with Label-Free Recovery
articles.zh: 少六层——Whisper编码器的剪枝与无标签恢复
articles.summary: 如果你部署Whisper嫌它太慢太大，这篇证明砍掉6层编码器还能靠无标注数据把效果救回来
articles.author: Rasmus Aagaard, Nicki Skafte Detlefsen
articles.body: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI's Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups. For instance, the {\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo} variant reduced the decoder from 32 to 4 layers, while Distill-Whisper similarly reduced the decoder to only 2 layers. Although some attention has been put towards reducing the size of the encoder, no approach has seen wide adoption. This could be due to the need for custom inference implementations to take advantage of the compressed model. We present an approach that ranks encoder layers by the leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate (WER). The six layers that cause the least change are removed, corresponding to $18.5\%$ of the encoder stack. The pruned model requires no custom inference code as it is simply a more shallow encoder with fewer layers. We further distill using unlabeled monolingual speech data to recover performance degradation caused by the zero-shot layer pruning. Mean WER across four languages increases to $20.1\%$ after distillation, compared to $21.9\%$ zero-shot, going from a baseline of $18.2\%$. We release all of our code (https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune) and the pruned model (https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned).
articles.bodyZh: 像 OpenAI 的 Whisper 这类基于 Transformer 的大型预训练自动语音识别（ASR）模型，现在被很多人拿来剪枝（pruning），因为把解码器（decoder）剪小以后，端到端转写速度能明显提上来。比如 whisper-large-v3-turbo 这个版本把解码器从 32 层砍到 4 层，Distill-Whisper 也类似，把解码器压到只剩 2 层。虽然也有人琢磨怎么缩小编码器（encoder），但目前还没有哪种做法被广泛采用。原因可能是，想真正吃到压缩模型的好处，还得自己写一套定制推理实现（custom inference implementations）。我们提出了一种办法：按逐层剔除（leave-one-layer-out）后词错误率（Word Error Rate, WER）的变化，给编码器各层排名。变化最小的六层会被删掉，差不多占整个编码器堆栈的 18.5%。剪完之后的模型不需要任何定制推理代码，因为它说白了就是一个层数更少、更浅的编码器。我们还用无标签的单语语音数据（unlabeled monolingual speech data）做蒸馏（distillation），把零样本层剪枝（zero-shot layer pruning）造成的性能下降尽量补回来。四种语言的平均 WER 在蒸馏后变成 20.1%，零样本剪枝时是 21.9%，而基线（baseline）是 18.2%。我们把所有代码（https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune）和剪枝后的模型（https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned）都公开了。

articles.title: Evaluation of pre-trained models for pedagogical assessment of novel AI-assisted educational questions
articles.zh: 面向AI辅助教育新题型的教学法评估：预训练模型评测
articles.summary: 如果你做教育类AI产品，这篇讲的是怎么用现成模型自动判断一道题出得好不好
articles.author: Michael Lawrence Castanares, Princess Ventures 等
articles.body: The surge in AI-assisted generation of educational materials has outpaced our capacity to validate their pedagogical quality. Automated evaluation using Bloom Classifier models is a promising approach to assess educational materials at scale. These models show high accuracy within-distribution dataset (IID Dataset). However, applying the same models to new out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets such as AI-assisted generated questions could show performance degradation. To identify robust classifiers under dataset shift, we evaluated traditional Machine Learning (ML), transformer, and Large Language models on the Bloom level classification task. We also explored feature-engineering strategies incorporating NLP metrics, appending the learning objectives as part of the input, and text splicing to stabilize OOD performance. Our baseline tests show that TFPOS-IDF ML models perform poorly on OOD (Macro F1-score 0.48) compared to BERT (0.55) and LLMs (0.79). Text splicing improved macro F1-score performance of ML and BERT models (0.59 and 0.62, respectively). Appending the learning objectives with the input increased model performance on specific dataset. Model retraining provided the largest improvement across models and datasets. Overall, these findings highlight the trade-off on the use of pre-trained models with novel AI-assisted educational questions and how strategic feature enhancements help address loss in performance.
articles.bodyZh: AI辅助生成教材的数量激增，已经远远超出了我们验证其教学质量的能力。用Bloom分类器模型进行自动化评估，是一种有前景的大规模评估教材的方法。这些模型在同分布数据集（IID Dataset）上表现出很高的准确率。但是，把同样的模型应用到新的异分布数据集（OOD数据集），比如AI辅助生成的问题上，性能可能会下降。为了找出在数据集发生变化时依然稳健的分类器，我们在Bloom层级分类任务上评估了传统机器学习（ML）、Transformer和大语言模型。我们还探索了融入NLP指标的特征工程策略、把学习目标附加到输入中，以及用文本拼接来稳定OOD性能。我们的基线测试显示，TFPOS-IDF机器学习模型在OOD上表现不佳（宏F1分数0.48），而BERT（0.55）和大语言模型（0.79）表现更好。文本拼接提升了机器学习和BERT模型的宏F1分数（分别达到0.59和0.62）。把学习目标附加到输入中，提升了模型在特定数据集上的表现。模型重新训练带来的提升最大，在所有模型和数据集上都是如此。总的来说，这些发现凸显了在面对新型AI辅助教育问题时，使用预训练模型需要权衡取舍，以及有策略的特征增强如何帮助弥补性能损失。

breakingNews.summary: 如果你在做配音、播客或有声内容，值得先试听一版再决定要不要换掉手上的 TTS
